text: {"identity":{"name":"Ivalina Hristova","institution":"European Association of Nuclear Medicine (EANM) / EANM Forschungs GmbH (EARL)","department":"Chief Scientific Officer, EARL (EANM Research Ltd.) – accreditation and research programmes","limitations":["Requested short name \"Iva Hristova\" was not found verbatim; verified sources give her name as Ivalina Hristova","No formal title was requested and none beyond Chief Scientific Officer was verified"],"citations":[{"aspect":"person","sourceId":"src_a0656494a428d0e7cf19ed9625a0086f","passageId":"text_3","explanation":"The official EANM Executive Office page lists Ivalina Hristova as Chief Scientific Officer within the EARL section, establishing the person and her role at the EANM/EARL organisation."},{"aspect":"department","sourceId":"src_a0656494a428d0e7cf19ed9625a0086f","passageId":"text_3","explanation":"Same official page places her under the EARL unit with the role Chief Scientific Officer, matching the requested accreditation-programme context (EARL runs EANM's accreditation programme)."},{"aspect":"institution","sourceId":"src_93c3dc7645487e403061aaf935001fc9","passageId":"text_1","explanation":"The EARL organisational structure page, maintained by EANM Forschungs GmbH, states EARL is a 100% daughter of the EANM non-profit Association and that one chief scientific officer oversees and coordinates the EARL projects and teams – linking Ivalina Hristova's role to the EANM accreditation/research initiative."},{"aspect":"authority","sourceId":"src_07ea7388da34245618636fae13401ec4","passageId":"text_1","explanation":"The official EARL website states EANM launched EANM Forschungs GmbH (EARL) and that EARL accredits PET/CT scanners, confirming that the EANM/EARL accreditation programme is the institutional context in which the Chief Scientific Officer operates."}]}}
